hikvision.whoIsText: Hikvision guarantees the highest quality at affordable prices. Founded in 2001, Hikvision focuses on integrated security and scenario-based digitalization, serving diverse industries with AI-powered Internet of Things (AIoT) technologies.
hikvision.whyTitle: Why buy only from an authorized installer?
hikvision.whyText: To better serve customers, Hikvision has created an excellent pre- and post-sales service network for technical support, selling its products exclusively through authorized distributors and installation/integration partners globally.
hikvision.whatText1: It's time to step into the future. Whether you're considering an upgrade or a scratch install, IP is the solution. It offers better image quality, higher resolution, and advanced features like AI, using fewer devices and cables. We offer a wide range of IP products including NVRs, PTZ dome cameras, panoramic cameras, and network transmission accessories.
hikvision.whatText2: Based on deep learning technology, DeepinView cameras and DeepinMind NVRs are among our most advanced products, allowing person/vehicle recognition and customer interest identification.

dahua.whoIsText: Dahua Technology is a world-leading video-centric AIoT solution and service provider.
dahua.whyText: Working with certified partners ensures you get the latest firmware updates and full warranty.
dahua.whatText1: We offer a complete range of AI-powered equipment for advanced protection.
dahua.whatText2: From facial recognition to perimeter protection, Dahua redefines security.
